# Office-cc 0.0.2

The second tagged build of the Office-cc desktop apps. Office-cc opens and
saves real `.docx`, `.xlsx` and `.pptx` files byte-preserving, edits PDF,
Markdown and HTML, and puts an AI agent next to every document — an editor
that reads the file and makes the change, not a chat box bolted to the side.

## Downloads

| Platform                    | File                            | Requirements                                      |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| macOS — Apple Silicon       | `Office-cc-0.0.2-arm64.dmg`     | macOS 11+, M-series (arm64)                       |
| macOS — Apple Silicon (zip) | `Office-cc-0.0.2-arm64-mac.zip` | same, for people who prefer not to mount an image |
| Windows — x64               | `Office-cc-0.0.2-x64-Setup.exe` | Windows 10+, Intel/AMD                            |

Drag `Office-cc` out of the `.dmg` into Applications on macOS; run the `.exe`
on Windows.

> **These installers are not code-signed and are not notarized.**
> macOS quarantines the app the first time it is opened: right-click the app →
> **Open** → **Open**, or run
> `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Office-cc.app`.
> On Windows, SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC" — click
> **More info → Run anyway**.

## New since 0.0.1

- **No account, no sign-in.** The Genspark account, login and cloud-project
  chain is gone: the app is standalone, your documents stay where you put
  them, and nothing is uploaded except the AI requests you send to the model
  you choose. Bring your own key for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi,
  GLM, Qwen, Doubao, MiniMax, Grok, Mistral, OpenRouter or any
  OpenAI-compatible endpoint — local servers included.
- **Open a folder with Office-cc.** Right-click a folder and choose **Open
  With → Office-cc** — in Finder on macOS and from the desktop entry on Linux.
  The folder joins the home sidebar as a workspace, so its files are
  searchable and editable without a second import step.
- **The AI feature buttons moved into the panel, for every format.** Summarize,
  polish, layout, generate, mind map, data check, beautify, key points, review
  summary and form fill no longer sit on the ribbon: the expanded AI panel now
  opens with a feature row at the top, and clicking it shows the buttons
  themselves — the one you press is the request that gets sent. It starts
  expanded and you can collapse it per app. Docs 5 entries, Sheets 2, Slides 3,
  PDF 5, Markdown 4, HTML 7. Pressing one while the AI is still answering
  queues the request instead of dropping it.

## Unchanged notes

- **Docs, Sheets and Slides** — native `.docx`, `.xlsx` and `.pptx` editors.
  Only the parts you edit are rewritten; everything else in the file survives
  byte-for-byte, so the documents keep working in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- **PDF** — edit the text inside a page, convert to Word, Excel or PowerPoint
  on-device, tables, shapes, links, watermarks, page numbers, forms and
  annotations included. Scanned pages are recovered with the platform OCR
  helper.
- **Ask AI across your files** — star the files that matter and ask questions
  in plain language; every answer cites the file it came from, one click away.
- **The `officecc` command line** — ships inside the app and installs the agent
  skill into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and friends from
  **Settings → Integrations**.
- **21 interface languages**, including English, Simplified Chinese and
  Traditional Chinese.

## Not in this release

- No Intel (x64) macOS build, no Windows on Arm build, and no Linux packages
  (deb, rpm, AppImage) yet.
- Both installers are unsigned, so the first launch needs the step described
  above. A signed, notarized build is planned.

Source, issues and the full manual: https://github.com/dcc123456/genoffice
